import json, sys
import mod.server.extraServerApi as api
factory = api.GetEngineCompFactory()
player = api.GetPlayerList()[0]
items = factory.CreateItem(player)
saved = sys._shield_r20_craft
restored = []
for slot, value in sorted(saved['ui'].items()):
    returned = items.SetPlayerUIItem(player, slot, value, False)
    actual = items.GetPlayerUIItem(player, slot, True)
    restored.append({'slot': slot, 'returned': returned, 'actual': actual, 'expected': value})
assert all(row['actual'] == row['expected'] for row in restored)
inventory_type = api.GetMinecraftEnum().ItemPosType.INVENTORY
actual_inventory = [items.GetPlayerItem(inventory_type, index, True) for index in range(36)]
assert actual_inventory == saved['inventory']
del sys._shield_r20_craft
_result = json.dumps({'restored': True, 'rows': restored, 'inventory_unchanged': True})
